title: rubus vulgaris f. carpinifolius
intro: Rubus vulgaris f. carpinifolius, commonly known as the wild bramble or dwarf raspberry, is a subspecies of the European bramble (Rubus fruticosus). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including aiding in the reduction of inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rubus vulgaris f. carpinifolius are thought to be due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
